items.title: exo runs Inkling 2 Mini at 210 tok/s decode on an M5 Ultra Mac Studio and 125 tok/s on an M5 Max MacBook Pro
items.summary: exo and Thinking Machines report optimized local inference for Inkling 2 Mini: 210 tok/s decode and 3,620 tok/s prefill on a 96GB M5 Ultra, 125 and 1,750 on a 48GB M5 Max, and a demo of the model building a native weather app 1.8x faster than Claude Sonnet 5.5.

doubt.pushback: Repliers ask which quantization and harness were used and whether the weather-app speed and cost comparison against Claude is like for like; no one reports reproducing the numbers.

reception.summary: Mostly enthusiasm about 125 tok/s on a laptop; a few ask for the quantization, harness, and a fair cost comparison, and others ask about smaller Macs. Nobody reports reproducing it.

items.title: LeRobot adds NAT VLA, a 450M vision-language-action policy with streamed decoding and real-time chunking
items.summary: LeRobot ships NAT VLA, a 450M-parameter robot policy built on LFM2-VL that packs 32-step action chunks into 14 tokens per group of 7 action dims. It supports streamed decoding and token-prefix real-time chunking in sync, async and remote modes, with checkpoints pretrained on DROID, Bridge, RT-1, BC-Z, YAM and SO-101 data.

doubt.pushback: Very new post; docs page read but no benchmark numbers or third-party runs seen yet.

items.title: Hy4-Flash gets Strata packs of 64, 96 and 128 GiB, runnable with an 8 GiB GPU
items.summary: Strata, a local inference engine, adds support for Tencent's 220B Hy4-Flash with its own quantized packs sized for 64, 96 and 128 GiB of RAM plus an 8 GiB or larger graphics card. The packs are on Hugging Face, with a model card covering quality versus the original and speed.

doubt.pushback: Model card claims are the author's own; not reproduced by Magpie.

items.title: Drama 3 voice model now runs out of the box on a 16 GB NVIDIA card, about 2.6x faster than real time on an RTX 5060 Ti
items.summary: A fix to the drama-tensorfold repo lets the 14.5 GB build of Drama 3 run on 16 GB NVIDIA GPUs. A third-party user measured about 2.6x faster than real time on an RTX 5060 Ti costing under 500 euros, with the fix and numbers in a public pull request.

doubt.pushback: Single user measurement reported by the author; not reproduced by Magpie.
